Realistic hand-painted late-90s dark fantasy inventory art, rich worn materials, aged steel, carved bone and wood, crisp bold silhouette and restrained highlights readable at 64px, consistent upper-left lighting. The entire object must be visible, centered in a square image with 15% empty padding. True transparent alpha background. No person, hands, mannequin, floor, setting, scenery, labels, lettering, readable runes, UI frame, watermark, floating particles, halo, drop shadow, or baked checkerboard. Distinctive geometry and ornamentation are essential; do not make a generic base-item recolor. For weapons use a diagonal from bottom-left grip to top-right head; keep the full long grip on two-handed weapons. Armor, boots and gloves are empty unworn inventory objects in frontal three-quarter view. For a pair of boots or gloves show exactly two pieces. For bows/crossbows include the taut string. For charms include the hanging cord. Jewels are loose minerals without a ring setting.
Named item: Doomglyph. Item type: glyph.
Bespoke design: A thick broken volcanic stone glyph with a deep skull-shaped carved mark filled with dim red crystal and chipped pointed edges.
Lore: Cut from a stone that had seen the end of things.
Signature power theme: Doombrand — Weapon hits against demons: inflict 100% of hit damage as fire damage over 3s. 5s cooldown. Duplicates do not stack. Doomguard — Damage received while at or below 40% Life: erupt within 2.5 yards for 50% of damage taken as fire damage; restore 6% of maximum Aether. 10s cooldown. Duplicates do not stack.
Existing authored palette cues: {"accent":"#ff5050"}. Use these as small material accents where appropriate; silhouette comes from the bespoke design.
No text anywhere in the artwork.
